risk.detail: Localization touches confirmation and recovery chrome; executable negative-path tests preserve the original fail-closed state and write boundaries.

observedIssues.fact: The first full ai-finish passed 1418 tests and 85.70% coverage, then the agent-risk guard rejected the before_edit checkpoint because scenario status evidence had changed the Contract hash after that checkpoint.
observedIssues.decision: Treat the stale checkpoint as fail-closed evidence, record the event, and re-run before_edit against the final Contract before retrying finish.
observedIssues.resolution: No gate was bypassed and no archive was created; the checkpoint will be rebound to the final Contract and the complete finish sequence rerun.
observedIssues.followUp: In future Work Items, finalize planned scenario structure before before_edit and record executed scenario evidence in Summary without changing Contract fields after checkpoint unless the checkpoint is deliberately refreshed.
